verdict.rationale: Vestd's own docs say founders can get a 409A valuation from Vestd for a small fee, framed for UK companies granting options to US taxpayers, and it has a share valuation page. Nothing shows the valuation is ordered in-platform, generated from live cap table data, audit-ready, or refreshed on a recurring schedule; it reads as a one-off paid service. Missing for 10: in-platform ordering flow, generation from live cap table data, audit-readiness/defensibility documentation, scheduled refreshes, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can order an audit-ready 409A valuation in-platform, generated from my live cap table data, and get refreshed valuations on schedule

citations.quote: Get your 409A valuation from Vestd for a small fee.
